gloss: going in and out; traffic; access

definitions.gloss: going in and out; entering and exiting
definitions.explanation: The act of going in and coming out of a place.
The flow of people or vehicles entering and leaving a place.
Variation or discrepancy, especially in numbers or amounts.

notes:
FORMS:
- {出|で} (going out) + {入|い}り (coming in)
- A compound noun combining opposite actions

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}→出入り口：21070_deiriguchi⟧ (entrance/exit)
- {出入|でい}り⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (entry/exit prohibited)
- {出入|でい}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧ (busy with traffic)

SIMILAR COMPOUND WORDS:
- {出|しゅつ}{入|にゅう} (formal reading: しゅつにゅう) - more formal, used in documents
- {入|い}り{出|で} (less common reverse order)

The casual reading でいり is standard; the formal on'yomi reading しゅつにゅう is used in official contexts like ⟦{出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}→出入国：24874_shutsunyuukoku⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (immigration control).
